column1: # Negotiation messages built by concatenation. JP regex (anchored) TAB EN template; see patterns_battle.tsv.
# Yen: the game font draws "\" as the yen sign (the code itself uses "\\"); a real ¥ shows up as a backslash.
# Two-line messages (StringArray[12] + [13]) are matched joined, so each template is one full sentence.
# --- Greeting a demon of a race you already have (Battle_TalkInit): "{hero}は{demon}と" + "親しげに挨拶を交わした"
# --- Results (Battle_TalkingMain)
([^、。「」『』…\n]+)は満足して去っていった
([^、。「」『』…\n]+)は仲魔になるのを考え直した
([^、。「」『』…\n]+)が襲い掛かってきた
# Recruit line: pronoun (one per voice) + "は、" + race + " " + name, then "今後ともヨロシク".
ワタシは、([^ ]+) (.+)今後ともヨロシク
column2: I am {1} {2}. From now on, I am yours.
